flow-talk-page-beta-feature-message: Doodaha Habaysan ee bogga doodda isticmaalaha
flow-talk-page-beta-feature-description:
Waxaa loo oggolaaday {{GENDER:|adiga}} inuu awood u geliyo nidaamka doodda habaysan bogga doodda isticmaalaha {{GENDER:|adiga}}. Doodaha Habaysan waxaa loo bixiyay sidii sifo beta ah, laakiin [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Structured_Discussions/Deprecation sifadan waxaa laga saari doonaa wikiyada]. Waxaan ku martiqaadeynaa {{GENDER:|adiga}} inaad tixgeliso curyaaminta sifadan si hore ah.

Curyaaminta sifadan waxay guddiga Doodaha Habaysan u wareejin doontaa bog-hoosaad waxayna ka saari doontaa kaydinta bogga doodda hore. [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Help:Structured_Discussions/Activation#deactivate Wax badan ka baro curyaaminta.] [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Talk:Structured_Discussions/Deprecation Nala soo xiriir haddii {{GENDER:|adiga}} aad la kulanto wax arrin ah.]
